Package client

Class Client

java.lang.Object
ocsf.client.AbstractClient
client.Client
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class Client extends AbstractClient
The Client class extends AbstractClient and serves as the client-side communication handler with the server. It manages various controllers and processes messages received from the server.

    • setOnDishListReceived

      public void setOnDishListReceived(Consumer<List<Dish>> onDishListReceived)
      Sets the callback to be executed when a list of dishes is received from the server. This callback is typically used to process and display the dishes in the client UI.
      Parameters:
      onDishListReceived - a Consumer<List<Dish>> that will be invoked when the list of dishes is received from the server.

    • setRestaurantWorkerController

      public void setRestaurantWorkerController(RestaurantWorkerController restaurantWorkerController)
      Sets the RestaurantWorkerController instance for the client. This method is used to establish a reference to the RestaurantWorkerController so that the client can interact with it, typically to update the UI or handle responses related to restaurant worker operations.
      Parameters:
      restaurantWorkerController - the RestaurantWorkerController instance to be associated with the client.

    • sendToServer

      public void sendToServer(Message message)
      Sends a Message to the server. This method is used to communicate with the server by sending a message object, which can include commands or data. It prints out the command being sent for debugging purposes and handles any exceptions that may occur during the process.
      Parameters:
      message - the Message object containing the command and data to be sent to the server.

    • setWatchreportscontroller

      public void setWatchreportscontroller(WatchReportsController watchreportscontroler)
      Sets the reference to the WatchReportsController instance. This method allows the Client class to interact with the WatchReportsController by storing the provided instance for future use.
      Parameters:
      watchreportscontroller - the WatchReportsController instance to be set.

    • setQuarterlyReportsController

      public void setQuarterlyReportsController(QuarterlyReportsController quarterlyReportsController)
      Sets the QuarterlyReportsController instance for this client. This method allows the client to interact with the QuarterlyReportsController by storing a reference to it, enabling updates and data exchange between the two.
      Parameters:
      quarterlyReportsController - the QuarterlyReportsController instance to be associated with this client.
